title: Inventec NA - Developer Documentation (Sample Customer Q&A)

items.question: What do I need before reflashing QC01W?
items.answer: Connect QC01W to your host computer using a Type-C cable, and connect an Ethernet cable to QC01W.

items.question: How do I put QC01W into EDL mode?
items.answer:
You can enter EDL mode in two ways:
- Option 1 (Command line): follow the command line instructions linked from the reflash page.
- Option 2 (Hardware buttons):
  1) Press and hold the Recovery button (Fn2) using a SIM card eject tool.
  2) While holding the button, plug in the power cable.
  3) Keep holding Fn2 for about 3 seconds, then release it.
  4) The indicator light remains dark blue, indicating QC01W is in EDL mode.

items.question: How do I confirm QC01W is in EDL mode?
items.answer: Check Device Manager on the host computer.

items.question: What is command-line EDL entry used for on QC01W?
items.answer: It is a reference for entering EDL (Emergency Download) mode using ADB/command line on supported operating systems, depending on what OS is running on the device before reflashing.

items.question: What do I need before using ADB commands to enter EDL mode?
items.answer: ADB must be installed on your host computer. Follow the “Install ADB on the host computer” instructions if it is not installed.

items.question: How do I enter EDL mode from the command line when QC01W is running QCLinux?
items.answer:
From the host PC terminal, run:
adb shell reboot edl
Also connect QC01W to the host PC over USB cable.

items.question: How do I enter EDL mode from the command line when QC01W is running Ubuntu 20.04 (Minimal)?
items.answer:
From the host PC terminal:
1) adb root
2) adb reboot edl
Also connect QC01W to the host PC over USB cable.

items.question: How do I enter EDL mode from the command line when QC01W is running Android?
items.answer:
From the host PC terminal:
1) adb root
2) adb reboot edl
Also connect QC01W to the host PC over USB cable.

items.question: Is command-line EDL entry supported on QC01W Ubuntu 24.04?
items.answer: No. Command-line EDL entry is not supported on Ubuntu 24.04. Use the hardware button method described on the image reflashing SOP page.

items.question: Is command-line EDL entry supported on QC01W Windows (IoT)?
items.answer: No. Command-line EDL entry is not supported on Windows (IoT). Use the hardware button method described on the image reflashing SOP page.

items.question: What host computer is required to refresh NCOX/NCON JetPack 5.1.2 image over Ethernet?
items.answer: A Linux Host PC/Notebook with Ubuntu Linux x64 20.04 or 18.04, and it must be able to connect to the device through LAN.

items.question: What files are included in the JP 5.1.2 OTA refresh package folder?
items.answer: The package folder includes the OTA image file (ota_payload_package.tar.gz), the OTA tool (ota_tools_V3.tar.bz2), and the script (ota.sh). Download all three to the host PC/notebook.

items.question: How do I start the OTA update for NCOX/NCON from the host PC?
items.answer:
Run the OTA script from the host PC, for example:
./ota.sh -i 192.168.55.1 -p ota_payload_package.tar.gz -t ota_tools_V3.tar.bz2 --port 22
Parameters:
- -i: target device IP
- -p: OTA package filename
- -t: OTA tool filename
- --port: target device SSH port (default 22)

items.question: How long does the NCOX/NCON OTA image refresh take, and what happens during the process?
items.answer: The update typically takes around 15–20 minutes. The host uploads the OTA tool and image, the target decompresses the files, checks package integrity, then starts updating automatically. The host monitors status and completes when the device reconnects to the network.

items.question: What happens if the OTA process takes longer than 30 minutes?
items.answer: If the host waits longer than 30 minutes, it aborts the OTA script and shows a warning message: "OTA status: Timeout please check device power".

items.question: How do I find the NCOX/NCON IP address for OTA/SSH?
items.answer: By default, the device’s Gigabit Ethernet port uses DHCP and will obtain an IP from the LAN router/access point after power on. Check your router/AP web interface for a device named like "AIM-dev-xxxx" to see its assigned IP.

items.question: What are the default SSH credentials for NCOX/NCON, and is there any first-login requirement?
items.answer: Default SSH credentials are Username: aim / Password: aim12345. For security, you will be asked to change the password on the first login.

items.question: How do I install ADB on a Windows host PC for QC01W command-line EDL entry?
items.answer: Download Android Platform Tools (platform-tools zip), extract it (for example to C:\platform-tools), then add that folder to your system PATH or open Command Prompt in that folder to run adb. Verify with: adb version.

items.question: How do I install ADB on Linux (Ubuntu/Debian) for QC01W command-line EDL entry?
items.answer:
Run: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y adb
Verify with: adb version.

items.question: How do I install ADB on macOS for QC01W command-line EDL entry?
items.answer:
With Homebrew: brew install android-platform-tools
Or download Platform Tools and add the extracted folder to PATH.
Verify with: adb version.
